Colon Cancer Treatment (PDQ) - Patient Version

General Information About Colon Cancer

Health history affects the risk of developing colon cancer.

Getting older is the biggest risk factor for most kinds of cancer, including cancer of the colon.

Treatment of Stages I and II Colon Cancer

Stage I colon cancer is usually treated with surgery to take out the cancer and some tissue around it.

Treatment of Stage IV and Recurrent Colon Cancer

When cancer has spread and cannot be removed by surgery, treatment is usually chemotherapy, sometimes with targeted therapy, to help people live longer.
